overview_description.description: Corgi Insurance is a business insurance provider that focuses on delivering coverage for startup and technology companies through a digital, software-driven platform. It offers commercial insurance products such as general liability, cyber insurance, directors and officers liability, and professional liability, structured into modular plans that can be adjusted based on company stage and risk profile. The platform provides instant quoting and policy issuance workflows intended to reduce manual underwriting steps and broker involvement. It operates as a full-stack insurance carrier, meaning it manages underwriting, policy creation, and claims handling within its own system. The company also integrates AI-supported processes to evaluate risk and streamline insurance administration for business customers. Its services are primarily used by early-stage and scaling companies that require standardized coverage for contracts, fundraising, and operational risk management.

about_short_description.short_description: Corgi Insurance is a business insurance provider that focuses on delivering coverage for startup and technology companies.

product.name: Startup Insurance Packages
product.description: Modular business insurance packages for technology startups at the Pre-Seed/Seed, Series A, and Growth stages, plus customizable policy combinations.

product.name: Commercial General Liability (CGL)
product.description: Coverage for third-party claims involving bodily injury, property damage, and specified personal or advertising injury arising from business operations.

product.name: Tech & AI Liability (Tech E&O)
product.description: Professional liability coverage for claims that technology products or services caused a client financial loss through errors, omissions, or negligent performance.

product.name: Cyber Liability
product.description: Coverage for losses and third-party claims arising from data breaches, cyberattacks, unauthorized access, and network security failures.

product.name: Directors & Officers (D&O) Liability
product.description: Coverage for claims against directors, officers, founders, and other company leaders alleging wrongful acts in managing the business.

product.name: Employment Practices Liability (EPLI)
product.description: Coverage for employment-related claims alleging wrongful termination, discrimination, harassment, retaliation, or other workplace violations.
